slices.name: ws01-23-semantic-colours-ink-surface
slices.brief:
WS01 slice 23 of 32 (checkpoint D, the design system; slices 20 to 32; its draft PR is #108). Branch redesign/ws01-design-system, HEAD bb8c8a6 (slice 22); the base for diffs is bb8c8a6. Checkpoints A, B and C are merged to main and live. Read first: REDESIGN_STATUS.md (Ordering rules, the acceptance table, Decisions (Tokens, The focus ring on a dark ground and Dark mode and the Appearance control from step 21, One scope mechanism from step 22), Deviations, Follow-ups (Dark mode on pages not converted yet, Dark grounds that are not a navy band and A light card inside a navy band, all step 21), and steps 21 and 22), docs/redesign/REDESIGN_SPEC.md section 1 (the decided look) and section WS01 (the base and dark palettes, the focus ring rule, 'Buttons: gold fill with navy text; never white on gold', and the gold text clean-up, which is slice 25 and not this one), src/index.css (both @theme blocks at lines 29 to 115, the legacy :root semantic tokens at lines 151 to 192, the new-look blocks, the shadcn re-pointing at lines 437 to 465 and the gold focus-ring rule at lines 481 to 488), src/lib/brand.ts (LCA and GOLD_BUTTON), node_modules/tailwindcss/theme.css (where white and the gray scale are defined), test/unit/tokens.test.ts, test/unit/token-utilities.test.ts and test/unit/helpers/cssTokens.ts (how index.css is parsed and how a utility is compiled with Tailwind's own compile()), scripts/move-files.ts and test/unit/move-files.test.ts (the convention for a repo script: a header comment with its usage, run with node --no-warnings --experimental-strip-types, a --dry-run, the TypeScript parser rather than text matching, and a unit test on a fixture tree), and the browser test harness (playwright.config.ts, test/a11y/support.ts, baseline.ts, baseline.json, smoke.spec.ts, tokens.spec.ts, known-violations.json) so the dark spot run follows its conventions and the flag-off baseline comparison stays green. The manifest entries for orders 24 and 25 say what this slice leaves to them (24: status colours, gray and slate stragglers, raw hex and the raw-colours ratchet; 25: text-lca-gold and the gold-ink codemod, which classifies grounds by bg-lca-navy or bg-brand-navy). The lead's notes win over this brief and the manifest where they differ: <scratchpad>/ws01-lead-notes.md. The manifest entry (order 23) is in <scratchpad>/ws01-manifest.json. node_modules is installed; nothing ever runs against a remote database or the Cloudflare account; agents never commit, stash, reset or check out anything; the working tree is the only copy.

Environment facts for this container: the pinned Playwright expects a Chromium build the container does not have, so every npm run test:a11y here runs as PW_CHROMIUM_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium npm run test:a11y (the config reads that variable); never run playwright install; WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false on every wrangler command; localhost is exempt from the outbound proxy, so the a11y servers on 127.0.0.1 work. Dependencies are exact-pinned (no caret) at versions at least two weeks old, with package-lock.json updated by npm install. The branch tip is bb8c8a6 (slice 22), the same commit the head of draft PR #108 carries, and the working tree is clean; the local main ref in this container is 4c1a466 and does not carry the checkpoint merges, so a diff against the local main shows far more than this slice: take this slice's own changes as the working tree against bb8c8a6.

Build exactly this. Make the existing pages theme-able for dark, live and heritage, part one: ink and grounds. scripts/codemods/semantic-colours.ts reads a reviewed map, scripts/codemods/semantic-colours.map.json, and rewrites TSX class strings:
- text-lca-navy -> text-ink
- bg-white -> bg-surface
- card and section grounds -> bg-surface or bg-surface-2
- border greys -> border-hairline
- bg-lca-navy heroes -> bg-brand-navy, a token that stays #1a2744 in every scope, so navy heroes stay navy in dark

text-white on navy grounds stays. text-lca-gold is not touched here (slice 25). Every mapped utility resolves under the legacy :root to exactly the colour it replaces, so with newLook off nothing changes. test/unit/semantic-map.test.ts proves this by checking each mapping pair against the legacy values parsed from index.css. Club colours (AdminClubPage, AdminPage swatches, clubColors.ts) are user data and stay inline styles. A person reviews every place where a mapped class sits on a coloured ground (badges, tinted banners) and records judgement calls in REDESIGN_STATUS.md.

Verify items from the manifest, each to be re-checked against the tree as it is now (the earlier finding follows): Hardcoded colour counts: in src, text-lca-navy 382, bg-lca-navy 103, bg-white 42, text-[#...] 39, bg-[#...] 8, text-emerald-* 62, text-red-* 19, and muted tokens are already used widely (re-checked with ripgrep at bb8c8a6, counting class tokens with their variant prefixes and opacity modifiers: text-lca-navy 381 in 72 TSX files, plus 1 in src/lib/brand.ts line 36 (GOLD_BUTTON); of the 381, 365 are plain, 13 hover:, 2 text-lca-navy/80 and 1 [&_a]:. bg-white 43 in 18 TSX files, but only 8 are opaque (7 bg-white and 1 hover:bg-white); the other 35 are translucent white on navy grounds (bg-white/5, /6, /10, /15, /20, /30, /40, /60 and /90, with their hover: forms). bg-lca-navy 102 in 45 TSX files (105 across src; the other three are in index.css): 79 opaque fills in 40 files, 4 hover:bg-lca-navy/90, and 19 light tints (/5 five times, /7 five, /8 two, /10 two, /55 once, the HomePage photo overlay at line 76, and /[0.03] to /[0.06] four times). text-[#...] 39 in 23 files, bg-[#...] 8 in 5, text-emerald-* 62 in 30 and text-red-* 19 in 11, all left to slice 24. Muted and shadcn grounds: text-muted-foreground 671 in 85 files, bg-muted 123 in 51, bg-card 95 in 34, bg-background 63 in 35 and border-border 93 in 22; these already follow the tokens under the new look (index.css lines 437 to 465), and on the legacy :root --muted and --surface-2 are both oklch(0.97 0 0) and --border and --hairline both oklch(0.922 0 0). 78 of the 106 TSX files under src hold at least one text-lca-navy, bg-white, bg-lca-navy or gray class.) Dark usage today: only one dark: or prefers-color-scheme reference outside components/ui, and the stock .dark block is never toggled (re-checked: no dark: utility in any TSX file outside src/components/ui, where button.tsx has four; prefers-color-scheme appears only in src/lib/colorScheme.ts and src/hooks/useColorScheme.ts from slice 21 and in src/assets/vite.svg; .dark is now set by slice 21, only when newLook is on, and the new-look dark tokens outrank the stock block). Further differences between the manifest's assumptions and the tree: Legacy identity holds for two pairs only. text-lca-navy compiles to var(--color-lca-navy), #1a2744 (index.css line 30), and text-ink to var(--ink), #1a2744 on the legacy :root (line 164; tokens.test.ts line 91 already holds them equal). bg-white compiles to var(--color-white), #fff, defined in node_modules/tailwindcss/theme.css line 323 and not in index.css, and bg-surface to var(--surface), #fff (line 161). So semantic-map.test.ts cannot read every legacy value from index.css alone: compile each pair with Tailwind's compile() over index.css's two @theme blocks plus Tailwind's theme, as token-utilities.test.ts does, and resolve the tokens with helpers/cssTokens.ts. Opacity forms match too: compiled with the repo's Tailwind 4.3.3, text-lca-navy/80 and text-ink/80 both become color-mix(in oklab, #1a2744 80%, transparent); only the fallback for a browser without color-mix differs (text-ink/80 falls back to var(--ink) at full strength). The grey pairs are not identical: border-gray-300 is oklch(87.2% 0.01 258.338) (theme.css line 229) while --hairline is oklch(0.922 0 0) (index.css line 166), and bg-gray-100 is oklch(96.7% 0.003 264.542) (theme.css line 227) while --surface-2 is oklch(0.97 0 0) (index.css line 162). The only grey uses are border-gray-300 twice in src/pages/TournamentPrintPage.tsx (lines 101 and 171, a print page), bg-gray-100 three times as the resolved badge ground (DashboardPage.tsx line 51, AdminSupportPage.tsx line 25, SupportPage.tsx line 24, each with text-gray-600), plus text-gray-600 and bg-slate-400 and bg-slate-500 that the map does not name. There is no bg-gray-50 and no bg-lca-cream use, so 'card and section grounds' finds nothing beyond bg-white. A grey mapping that is not identical breaks this slice's own rule: leave the greys to slice 24 (its map covers gray and slate stragglers) or give them a legacy-exact token, and record which. bg-brand-navy does not exist: there is no --brand-navy token or utility. bg-lca-navy already compiles to var(--color-lca-navy), a literal in the @theme block (line 30) that no scope or dark block redefines, so navy grounds already stay #1a2744 in dark and in every scope; the rename is for naming only. Add the token inside the existing @theme block (token-utilities.test.ts line 19 requires exactly two @theme blocks). The gold focus ring in navy bands is keyed to the class: index.css line 485, ':root[data-look="new"] .bg-lca-navy :focus-visible', is pinned by tokens.test.ts lines 340 to 351 and measured on the footer by tokens.spec.ts line 310, so renaming the class without extending that rule to .bg-brand-navy turns the ring navy on navy in the header, footer and heroes under newLook. Decide whether the 4 hover:bg-lca-navy/90 fills and the 19 navy tints map (to bg-brand-navy with the modifier, or to an ink tint that lightens in dark) and record it. Navy text on gold: 55 lines in 34 TSX files put text-lca-navy beside a bg-lca-gold ground. 40 lines in 30 files are the opaque gold button, a copy of GOLD_BUTTON (which 19 files import; HomePage.tsx line 21 keeps its own copy, and AnnouncementBanner.tsx line 14 is the gold banner); the rest sit on gold tints. The brief requires navy text on gold in every look, and text-ink is #e8ecf4 in dark, about 1.9:1 on #c8a94a, so these cannot become text-ink. Another 10 lines put text-lca-navy beside a navy fill or tint. Each is a judgement call the person records; a scope-fixed navy text utility beside bg-brand-navy keeps the acceptance line on text-lca-navy true. GOLD_BUTTON in src/lib/brand.ts (line 36) is a .ts file, outside the TSX rewrite. Opaque bg-white: of the 8, five are white mats that must stay white in dark: club logos (WorkspacePage.tsx line 193, ClubsPage.tsx 64, ClubDetailPage.tsx 153, AdminClubPage.tsx 442) and the two-factor QR code (AccountSecurityPage.tsx 219, which a phone must scan on white). The others are the TournamentManagePage tab bar (line 1113), the LCAMap control on the map (LCAMap.tsx 468) and the ScannerPage remove button over a photo (line 448, bg-white/90 hover:bg-white). The 35 translucent bg-white uses sit on navy and stay, like text-white. Record each exception with its reason in the map. Navy grounds outside class strings: ClubDetailPage.tsx line 141 and AdminClubPage.tsx line 266 draw the hero with style={{ backgroundColor: LCA.navy, borderBottomColor: color }} (the border is the club colour, the ground is not); each holds a Link, and AdminClubPage also a button, so under newLook their focus ring is navy on navy, a case missing from the step 21 follow-up. AdminEmailPage.tsx (lines 62 to 86) is an email preview drawn with inline literals and stays literal. src/lib/viewOnly.tsx (line 35) is a TSX file under src/lib that the src/**/*.tsx glob includes. Step 21 follow-ups this slice meets: 'Dark grounds that are not a navy band' (REDESIGN_STATUS.md line 1057) says whichever step first draws the HomePage hero and AnnouncementBanner's urgent (#9b1c1c) and info (#1e4d7b) tones under the new look puts data-ground="dark" on the element that holds their controls; this slice rewrites classes in both files (HomePage.tsx: 4 text-lca-navy, 9 bg-white forms, 2 bg-lca-navy; AnnouncementBanner.tsx lines 14 and 15), so add the markers or record why not. 'Dark mode on pages not converted yet' (line 1055) keeps newLook off until steps 23 and 24 land. Lint: 18 of the 34 errors sit in 10 TSX files this rewrite touches (LCAMap.tsx 9; ClubLocationPicker.tsx, PostsPanel.tsx, ResultsEntry.tsx, UsChessMembership.tsx, FacebookFeed.tsx, src/lib/viewOnly.tsx, ContactPage.tsx, ScannerPage.tsx and SupportPage.tsx 1 each; rules react-hooks/refs, react-hooks/set-state-in-effect, react-hooks/use-memo, react-refresh/only-export-components and no-unused-vars), and all 13 warnings sit in touched files; the gate's rule for errors in a touched file applies to them, so list each fix in the report. Baseline and dark run: test/a11y/baseline.json covers four routes (/, /tournaments, /membership and /tournaments/fx-t-done) and four elements on each (body, the first Button, a table header and a font-mono element), so it cannot see a heading or link colour; semantic-map.test.ts is the proof of identity. No spec runs axe in dark today: smoke.spec.ts runs axe on / in the light look only, and step 21's follow-up leaves dark, live and heritage under axe to the step 32 sweep. The dark spot run on /, /tournaments and /membership is new: add it as a spec on a11y-on with colorScheme dark (so <html> carries .dark) or quote a recorded run, record which, and list any colour-contrast violation it finds with its cause (known-violations.json already lists muted-grey ones on / for a11y-off). Build size: npm run check:bundle checks only that no zod reaches dist/assets and measures no size, so report the built CSS and JS sizes in dist/assets before and after. New files: scripts/codemods (the folder), semantic-colours.ts, semantic-colours.map.json and test/unit/semantic-map.test.ts do not exist yet. Scripts under scripts/ are linted (eslint.config.js line 76) but sit in no tsconfig, so typecheck does not cover them. Records: no acceptance-table row owns this step (the plan's exactly-one mapping gives orders 23 and 24 no AC or K item), so add one in the table's own pattern. The WS01 header (REDESIGN_STATUS.md lines 16 and 17) still says the branch is not pushed and there is no PR, while draft PR #108 is open with its head at bb8c8a6. Brief: REDESIGN_SPEC.md WS01 names no ink and surface codemod; this step comes from the plan, because dark follows the device as soon as newLook is on with no separate darkMode flag (decision 6 in the lead's notes).

Gate before reporting: npm run lint (baseline 34 errors and 13 warnings, measured on this tree; the error total never rises and every error in a touched file is fixed; report before and after), npm run build, npm run typecheck:functions, npm run check:bundle, npm run test:all (unit 2236 in 94 files and integration 790 in 58 files before this slice; report the counts), and then PW_CHROMIUM_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium npm run test:a11y end to end in this container with its output quoted (both builds, the flag-off baseline compared and unchanged, the dark spot run's results; 111 passed and 18 skipped before this slice). test/a11y/baseline.json must not be rewritten: with newLook off nothing visible changes, and a baseline difference is a defect in the slice. If an integration file fails to load as a whole on the first run, rerun that file alone once before treating it as real. Standing rules: no AI references anywhere, in code, code comments, docs or commit text; read the real file before changing it; match repo conventions; WCAG 2.2 AA; plain language ('US Chess', a weekday on every date, '7:00 PM'); no em dashes in anything you write; fixtures contain nothing real; new packages exact-pinned. The recorder updates REDESIGN_STATUS.md (a step 23 block; the acceptance table row this slice proves, added in the table's own pattern if none fits; decisions; deviations; the judgement calls; each resolved verify item; the counts) and, if the slice deviates from the brief, the step 23 sentence in the WS01 deviations list of docs/redesign/REDESIGN_SPEC.md, and drafts the commit text into <scratchpad>/slice23-commit.txt: a subject under 72 characters and plain prose, no attribution or co-author lines, no session links, no em dashes. The step records, the acceptance table and Decisions must not use the words slice, builder, scout, planner, recorder, manifest, subagent, workflow or the phrase the lead.
files: test/unit/tokens.test.ts (the navy-band focus selector, only if bg-brand-navy is added)
test/a11y/ (the dark spot run, if it is added as a spec)
docs/redesign/REDESIGN_SPEC.md (the step 23 deviation sentence, only if needed)
acceptance: Gate green, test/a11y/baseline.json unchanged, and the build size change negligible (dist/assets CSS and JS sizes reported before and after)
No text-lca-navy or bg-white remains in TSX, apart from the exceptions the map lists, each with a reason
semantic-map.test.ts proves every replacement resolves to the identical legacy colour, and the a11y-off baseline on /, /tournaments and /membership is unchanged
With newLook on and .dark set, a spot run of axe on /, /tournaments and /membership shows no colour-contrast violation caused by navy-on-dark text or white grounds
REDESIGN_STATUS.md records this slice's acceptance row, the judgement calls, any deviation and each resolved verify item
